# lean-pkg claims ledger

per-claim closure from the recorded evidence: verified only with zero diagnostics; read-only; exit 0 only when the package is ready.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg claims ledger [--stage {gate,promote}] [common flags] NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--stage {gate,promote}` | the authority required: gate (lower tier) or promote (also the comparator tier for every reusable theorem and lemma; the default). Choices: `gate`, `promote`. |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `claims ledger NAME` | read-only, nothing stored: each claim (the claims file at the gate-bound commit, else the cache, else the file committed at `HEAD`) with named diagnostics from the recorded receipts, re-checked with `gate`'s and `promote`'s validators; a claim is `verified` only with zero diagnostics, else `out-of-scope`, `blocked`, `unknown` or `open`; the package is `ready`, `open`, `failed` or `unknown` (fails closed: no claims or no `reusable` claim is `unknown`); `--stage promote` (default) also requires the comparator tier for reusable theorems and lemmas, `--stage gate` only the lower tier; exit 0 only when `ready`; `--json` adds `ledger_digest`; codes and rules in [Lifecycle](../lifecycle.md#claims-ledger). Manuscript findings (`manuscript_findings`, `statement_basis: corrected`; [schema](../prior-art.md#manuscript-findings)) are listed per claim with one summary line and `--json` `manuscript_findings`, and change no status; a `lean_evidence` declaration missing at the gate-bound commit is `finding-evidence-missing` | `[--stage gate\|promote]` `[--json]` |

## Exit codes

Exit 1 is also a negative answer here:

- `claims ledger NAME`: the ledger is not ready

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `claims-ledger` (exit 0): `bound_commit`, `claims`, `claims_source`, `comparator_sha256`, `counts`, `ledger_digest`, `manuscript_findings`, `name`, `ok`, `package_status`, `reasons`, `receipt_sha256`, `required`, `schema`, `stage`
